about: CHIM rooms (tools/chim/interior.py room_input): settings every room is built with. cut_models_over: a placed model wider than this (local units) is stored as tiles of the room grain (chim.cut tile mode, the exterior's large-model cut), so the engine culls each tile against the view on its own; a whole-room shell such as the Vivec Arena Pit's bowl (in_v_arena_01, 15,760 faces, one entity, always drawn whole: PERF-ARENA-PIT-SLOW-48) is otherwise sent through the clip path in full every frame. 0 keeps every model whole (the method up to v0.0.54-dev1). detail_budget: a named budget of config/chim-detail-budgets.json for room meshes (fewer visual triangles, the same collision, the open rim locked); null = none. room_types (the maintainer, 2026-10-28: the Arena Pit's methods behind one saved setting, aw_vivec_arena_pit_type): a room built in several types, each with its own cut_models_over and detail_budget; the default type's record is rooms/<room>.crm, every other type's rooms/<room>t<N>.crm on the same store, and the engine loads the type the setting names (-1, the default setting: this default). rooms: the only rooms that get these (the rooms they were measured for); every other room is built as before, every model whole and no budget (the maintainer, 2026-10-28, on blank walls in a dev2 room: we can't have walls like that except in the vivec arena pit).
recipe_rooms_about: recipe_rooms {room map: visual recipe of config/visual-recipes.json}: in these rooms only, the meshes the recipe names with a ratio (source + packet SHA-256) go through meshoptimizer with locked borders and the seam gate (tools/chim/interior.py room_recipe, MESHOPT-HOT-MODELS-57); no tiles, no budget, every other mesh and room as before. rie242a8d69e = Ald-ruhn, Manor District (its two shell halves: 5,529 and 4,781 to 2,431 and 2,857 triangles)
hollow_bevels_about: The standing bevels of every hollow model's collision plates where a room or room type does not set its own hollow_bevels (COLLISION-WORLDWIDE-REDUCTION-64; the maintainer's decision, 2026-11-10): 2 = approximate everywhere, as every solid model (the default); 1 = exact on the near-horizontal plates only; 0 = exact on every plate (the method up to v0.0.64-dev4). A room opts back in with its own hollow_bevels 0. Rooms only: exterior frames keep their hollow profiles' bevels (authored underpasses and walkways) until their own sweep. Builder option --chim-hollow-bevels overrides this default.

rifa4ef181ed.about: Akulakhan's Chamber (the Heart Chamber), the setting aw_vivec_arena_pit_type (it picks the type of every room with types): the standing bevels of its hollow collision plates (AKULAKHAN-CHAMBER-32MB-STALL-53). 0 = exact on every plate (the method up to v0.0.64-dev3; the room's models need about 18,130 KiB and do not load at 32 MB Fast), 1 = exact on the near-horizontal plates (floors, stair treads, ledges; a plate's own corners do not say which side is up, so flat ceilings count too), approximate on the walls, 2 = approximate everywhere (as every non-hollow model). Store models measured 18,579,456 (0), 15,621,904 (1), 14,142,096 bytes (2); at 32 MB Fast only type 2 loads (2,519 KiB Fast RAM free inside). Standing-box sweep along every wall: no point where type 2 lets the box further in than type 0; it stops the box earlier at 2.3 % of the sampled wall points in the cave and 5.5 % in Akulakhan (mostly 1 to 4 units; at 2 to 3 per 1,000 of the far samples by 48 units or more). Type 3 = type 2 and a detail budget for its drawn meshes (heart-chamber: Akulakhan 15,217 -> 6,000 triangles, cave 6,532 -> 4,000, bridge 1,864 -> 1,200; collision unchanged), the Vivec Arena Pit's method. Default 3 (the maintainer's decision, 2026-11-10; type 2 was the first type that loads).

vai000.about: Vivec, Arena Pit: 0 = the bowl whole (the original, the method up to v0.0.54-dev1), 1 = tiles, 2 = tiles + the room detail budget (the bowl at 6,000 visual triangles). Default 2, decided by the maintainer on 2026-10-28 (about 07:2x +0200) after the one-image A/B of that night (frame ms floor/ring: type 0 17.4/27.5, type 1 14.5/23.2, type 2 13.9/18.0): 'Type 2 is more than good enough ... keep in our builder the original as type 0, type 1, type 2, and 2 would be our default from now on'. Type 4 (tiles + the lossless planar merge, the room setting merge_faces) was measured equal to type 1 (-43 faces) and is not built (image space); the setting stays available.
